title: Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China's most powerful AI models — uh oh, Jensen! | TechCrunch
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang left the company this week after admitting to his affair with Alice Huang, executive of Megaspeed, a company implicated in smuggling Nvidia chips into China. The U.S. government’s treatment of Nvidia and Megaspeed is also under scrutiny.
